reference.shortdesc:

section.p:
Consider a

element where the author has formatted an admonition using a label followed by the admonition text, rather than using a

with a class attribute.

entry.codeblock: Warning: Always back up your data before performing a firmware update.
<note type="warning"> Always back up your data before performing a firmware update. </note>

section.p:
Result: The converter detects the label pattern at the start of a

element and maps it to the appropriate element. The label text and separator (:) are stripped from the DITA output — only the admonition body text is preserved inside the element.
section.note: The bold-label pattern is a fallback. Use class-based admonition elements such as <div class=\"warning\"> for reliable conversion.
